scope: Exact selected user-library references; read-only local Zotero metadata/export plus online primary sources.

library_metadata.title: Intrinsic functional and structural network organization in the macaque insula

references.method: Nineteen male rhesus monkeys; functional and diffusion MRI assessed with 31 matched insula seeds. Within-subject dorsal-minus-ventral anterior-insula functional connectivity differences were permutation tested. F99 appears in published coordinate/visualization conventions. No within-subject histology.
references.application: Use matching source regions and distinguish continuous gradients from parcel assignments. Transfer neither F99 coordinates nor MRI-derived parcels directly to NMT cytoarchitecture.

library_metadata.title: Functional characterization of macaque insula using task-based and resting-state fMRI

references.method: Published macaque insula task-based and resting-state fMRI study.
references.application: Functional specialization supplies hypotheses for INS subregions; task/rest responses do not establish monosynaptic output.
references.verification: Exact title/authors/DOI verified in primary bibliographic record. Detailed original methods were not accessible in this pass; do not substitute the related 2023 clustering paper.

library_metadata.title: Insular Cortical Projections to Functional Regions of the Striatum Correlate with Cortical Cytoarchitectonic Organization in the Primate

references.method: Primate anterograde and retrograde tracing relates insular cytoarchitecture to striatal projection territories.
references.application: Independent directional anatomical hypotheses; original tracer territories are not automatically identical to current MRI atlas parcels.

library_metadata.title: Modular architectonic organization of the insula in the macaque monkey

references.method: Modular architectonic organization of macaque insula.
references.application: Fine source-parcel validation needs independent cytoarchitecture; a nearest template label or coordinate rescue is insufficient.
references.verification: Exact library bibliographic metadata inspected; full methods not reopened in this pass.

library_metadata.title: Mapping brain-wide excitatory projectome of primate prefrontal cortex at submicron resolution and comparison with diffusion tractography

export_corrections.action: Removed Saad Jbabdi, Timothy E Behrens and Pavel Osten from derived author list; original article has 19 authors ending Zheng Wang.

references.method: Viral bulk tracing and serial two-photon tomography compared with diffusion tractography. Injection volume was mapped to dMRI for seeding; common-template axonal-density and tractography maps were compared with Dice and pixel-wise Pearson correlation.
references.application: Match injection/source locations and common coordinates. Fluorescent axonal density, reconstructed skeleton length and tractography counts are different observables; agreement can coexist with anatomically important disagreements.
references.verification: Primary methods and original author list verified online.

library_metadata.title: Multimodal Correspondence between Optogenetic fMRI, Electrophysiology, and Anatomical Maps of the Secondary Somatosensory Cortex in Nonhuman Primates

references.method: Four squirrel monkeys, five hemispheres; S2 optogenetic fMRI with electrophysiological localization/validation and virus-free optical controls. Anatomical expression was assessed histologically in one subject. Low-power BOLD related to LFP more closely than spikes.
references.application: Useful stimulation/anatomy correspondence precedent, with explicit species, cortical area and stimulation-modality limits. Electrical MSTIM does not inherit excitatory-cell selectivity; BOLD is not an axon-strength measurement.
references.verification: Primary methods, Figure 6 caption and discussion inspected through indexed primary article content. No unverified same-neuron pairing or whole-brain registration precision asserted.

library_metadata.title: Single-neuron projectomes of macaque prefrontal cortex reveal refined axon targeting and arborization

references.method: Macaque PFC single-neuron projectomes: 2,231 reconstructed neurons from seven monkeys, with fMOST and collaborative proofreading.
references.application: Closest measurement precedent for reconstructed axon extent/arborization. PFC subtype count and guided taxonomy do not establish INS parcel or subtype identities.
references.verification: Primary publication identity and acquisition/reconstruction scope verified online; detailed earlier review remains separately dated.

library_metadata.title: Cytoarchitectonic and connection stripes in the dysgranular insular cortex in the macaque monkey

references.method: Macaque dysgranular insula tracer-patch boundaries compared with adjacent cytoarchitectonic/myeloarchitectonic sections.
references.application: Fine stripes require adjacent tissue/architecture evidence; coordinate compatibility and cluster stability cannot establish those boundaries.
references.verification: Primary publication identity and method scope verified online; prior source review retained separately.

library_metadata.title: Multimodal analysis demonstrating the shaping of functional gradients in the marmoset brain | Nature Communications

export_corrections.action: Incomplete library webpage locally enriched to the verified 2022 journal article; Zotero unchanged.

references.method: Tong and colleagues, 2022: 39 marmosets with 709 resting-state scans across two centers. Functional gradients were compared across modalities; spatial autocorrelation-preserving surrogate maps were used for spatial significance.
references.application: Treat arousal/state and sampling level explicitly. Spatial-null principle is transferable; marmoset gradients, reference space and fitted parameters need macaque-specific validation.
references.verification: Primary metadata, sampling and spatial-null methods verified online. Library item is an incomplete webpage, enriched only in this exported artifact.

combining_design: Keep candidate eligibility, reviewed source parcel, animal/injection identity, tracing quality and registration status as separate manifest fields; 251637 coordinate-reference compatibility does not accept anatomy.

Build descriptive child-type-2 template-space skeleton-length/density maps per neuron; average within animal and source subregion before equal-animal summaries. Preserve source counts, outside-FOV/mask accounting and missing sources.

Use accepted individual MSTIM stimulation-site contrasts, particularly pos1/Ial, separately for each subject/session. Preserve task, run exclusions, current, site/depth, state and GLM contrast definition.
Resolve crossmodal animal linkage before paired claims. If animals remain unmatched, describe group-template spatial correspondence; do not imply same-neuron or same-animal validation.
Bind both modalities to exact NMT reference hashes and validate transform order, units, laterality and local insular landmarks; F99, marmoset and squirrel-monkey coordinates are not NMT.

Use a common valid-coverage domain and prespecified parcel summaries as primary exploratory comparisons. Distinguish raw skeleton length, normalized raw-length fractions, BOLD contrast effects and t statistics; keep log display transforms separate.

Evaluate continuous map/parcel correspondence and threshold-sensitivity overlap as different summaries. Match effective spatial scale through explicit conservative aggregation; account for residual registration error and avoid treating resampled voxels as independent observations.

Keep spatial-null testing distinct from animal-level inference. Validate domain-specific autocorrelation-preserving surrogates before p values; cortical spins do not directly apply to subcortex/whole volumes. Animal-level signed contrasts require identifiable design, independent animal replication and multiplicity control.

Report modality-specific agreement and disagreement without claiming direct synapses, population projection absence, or functional excitation from positive BOLD alone. CM033 remains blocked until current alignment/GLM acceptance.
